power.title: 5 V input, protection and 3.3 V buck
power.notes:
Regulated 5 V +/-5%, 2 A, terminal 1 positive. USB VBUS is NOT a power input.
Check PCB thermal/current loops and external PSU before energizing.

processor_1.title: ESP32-S3FN8 / USB programming (1/2)
processor_1.notes:
Wired Ethernet only. Leave LNA_IN open and never initialize Wi-Fi/BLE.
GPIO26..32 used by internal quad flash: do not route. GPIO45 pulled low selects 3.3 V flash.

processor_2.title: ESP32-S3FN8 / USB programming (2/2)
processor_2.notes:
Wired Ethernet only. Leave LNA_IN open and never initialize Wi-Fi/BLE.
GPIO26..32 used by internal quad flash: do not route. GPIO45 pulled low selects 3.3 V flash.

ethernet_1.title: W5500 / HR911105A Ethernet (1/3)
ethernet_1.notes:
WIZnet RJ45 reference topology. HR911105A pin numbering differs from J1B1211CCD.
100-ohm differential MDI routing; crystal load caps need final frequency measurement.

outputs_1.title: Output latches / timed drive rail (1/2)
outputs_1.notes:
595 stores 20 output bits; unused 4 outputs not connected. Shift 24 zeros before OE low.
SPI traffic shifts internal register only; latch ONLY after a complete output frame. Never latch Ethernet data.
Timer: nominal 16.8 s, qualify 8..25 s with capacitor bias/tolerance. Firmware long press 5 s.
One command at a time. Repeated trigger edges can extend a 555 pulse: firmware is not a safety-rated system.

host01_1.title: Host 01: isolated controls / LEDs (1/3)
host01_1.notes:
All HOST_REF and ESD grounds on this sheet belong only to this host.
Case buttons and LEDs remain straight-through on passive adapter. No host power is supplied on the cable.
LED input envelope: 0..5 V common-mode; OFF differential <=0.2 V; ON >=1.4 V. Qualify actual motherboard.
LM393 inputs tolerate positive voltage with VCC=0; 100k series limits signal loading. Not a universal F_PANEL map.

adapter.title: Passive host adapter
adapter.notes:
Build 10 identical copies. This board has no active parts and no power supply.
2.54 mm pairs are labelled by function, not motherboard physical pin number. Connect by motherboard manual.
Pin 9 goes to separately verified host signal ground. Pin 10 stays NC at both cable ends.
To save a separate PCBA setup: order bare PCBs and hand-solder connectors, or substitute a crimped Y harness.
